*Sapphire Packs will be added to top prizing based on how many are left over after the participation prizes are given out!

*Regional Invite Cards awarded to top 16!


Lunch Break- 45 Minute after round 3

Parking is free if you park in the parking Garage(as long as some sort of big event in the Stadium did not decide to pop up), 3rd floor gets into the convention center. You have to go down the escalator once inside, go to the other side of the convention center and go back up the other escalator.

Tickets will be Non Refundable once the event has started. You must show up in person to receive your entry prizing.
